answer: Each identity opens one vault, locks 90 credits, and files a dawn balance. Each transfer needs a wander receipt signed by the vault branch, binding amount, key, and epoch. An auditor recomputes the dawn balance from the prior balance plus receipts minus withdrawals; a mismatch or reused receipt burns the bond, and a rented-wander ring fails because a rented receipt names its original key. Opening costs 25 plus 3 per earlier vault that epoch, so the kth fake pays 25+3(k-1), the 1000th pays 3022, and 1000 fakes pay 1,523,500. An honest agent locks 90 once and pays 25 once.
